prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one 4:3 landscape painting for The Burnt Book Sanskrit learning story. Request 1536 x 1152 native output or the closest supported native 4:3 resolution. Refined Indian watercolor with restrained gouache on warm ivory paper; organic detail, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta, muted indigo. Warm, gentle, evocative storytelling, consistent character design.
Canonical scene brief: The wide pale Gaṅgā at morning with a hand with five spread fingers rising from the water; a proud king in red and gold on the brick steps pointing in astonishment; a calm tall scholar-minister beside him holding up two fingers of one hand; a lean grey-bearded man a little behind, looking downcast.
Character appearances:
yogananda: A heavy king in rich red and gold, a thick jewelled necklace, rings on every finger, a restless proud look; shown human, never monstrous.
vararuci-elder: A tall, calm, middle-aged scholar-minister in a clean white dhoti and shawl, a thin sacred thread, quick bright eyes and a steady half-smile; the same eyes as the boy.
shakatala: A middle-aged minister, lean and grey-bearded, in a once-fine but now dusty cream robe, with a long patient face and the bent back of someone who has learned to bow.
Phone-first composition: clear compact narrative grouping, essential faces, hands and objects comfortably inside all edges. Show the complete scene without border. No collage or multi-panel layout.
Writing is permitted by the owner. This particular scene needs no readable inscription; focus on its narrative. Do not invent scripts or fill small objects with pseudo-lettering. No watermark or UI.
